title: Magnet.fla Scene 5 Symbol 6 MovieClip frozen on frame 1 (doesn't play internal frames)
description:
## Symptom (user report)
Importing Magnet.fla (fixtures/) and playing the published SWF: in Scene 5, the
"Symbol 6" MovieClip on "Layer 5" (a masked layer) does NOT play its internal
frames — it is frozen on frame 1. The MC has 16 keyframes spanning 74 frames
across 3 layers with 20 tweens. The user added trace("frame 1")/trace("frame 2")
inside the MC and only "frame 1" ever logged.

## Repro (CONFIRMED at runtime in headless Ruffle 0.2.0)
The import + symbolType classification + loop-control synthesis are all CORRECT.
The freeze is at the runtime-playback layer: a structurally-complete nested
DefineSprite never advances its own playhead.

- Symbol 6 = library item `symbol-81-*`, name "Symbol 6", correctly classified
  symbolType="movieclip" (3 layers, keyframe indices 0..73 => 74-frame span, 20
  tweens). (There is a second smaller "Symbol 6" = `symbol-42-*`, 1 layer, 1
  frame — NOT the user's MC.)
- Scene 5 (doc.scenes[1]) layer "Layer 5" (masked) frame 0 places symbol-81 once
  (single keyframe, persists), imported with loopMode="single-frame" (the binary
  per-instance loop-mode byte, exactly as task 1124 describes for movieclips).

Direct runtime proof (standalone SWF placing only Symbol 6 on a multi-frame root,
loaded into bundled Ruffle, root-level frame script `trace('cf=' + mc._currentframe)`):
  cf=1, cf=1, cf=1, ... (forever) — max _currentframe observed = 1.
The MC is VISIBLE (renders its frame-1 content) but its playhead never advances.
A second control SWF whose ROOT keyframes alternate two symbols animates fine
(screenshot diff 148270) — so the root timeline ticks/plays correctly; only the
nested MovieClip's own timeline is frozen. A second nested MC (Symbol 27,
symbol-65, 19-frame span) is ALSO frozen the same way — this is general to nested
MCs, not specific to Symbol 6.

## Root cause — NOT (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) from the loop-control family
All four hypothesized causes are RULED OUT by swf-dump of the published SWF:
- (a) symbolType: Symbol 6 imports correctly as "movieclip"
  (packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts:1641-1644 SYMBOL_TYPES; :2073-2074).
  NOT misclassified as "graphic". So the graphic-only loop synthesis does not apply.
- (b) loop-control synthesis: the gate is INTACT and reached. In the published
  SWF the Symbol 6 PlaceObject2 carries NO clipActions (no synthesized
  gotoAndStop(1)). Verified: the FIRST-PLACEMENT gate
  packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts:885-888 computes isGraphicInstance=false ->
  loopMode="loop" for symbol-81 (instrumented log:
  `[DBG FIRST-PLACE] sym=symbol-81-... type=movieclip rawLoopMode=single-frame -> loopMode=loop isGraphic=false`).
  The MOVE path is never hit for this single placement. All 1466 @flash/swf unit
  tests pass (loopmode.test.ts "movieclip instances ignore loopMode" green).
  NOTE for follow-up: the MOVE path packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts:1435
  (`const moveLoopMode = displayObj.loopMode ?? "loop"`) is NOT gated on
  symbolType==="graphic" the way the first-placement path (886) and sprite.ts
  (234) are — a latent gap that would mis-synthesize on a moved movieclip with
  loopMode="single-frame", but it does NOT cause THIS freeze (Symbol 6 is a single
  persistent placement).
- (c) DefineSprite frame emission: COMPLETE. The Symbol 6 sprite (spriteId from
  charIdMap; swf-dump id 218 in full Magnet / id 234 standalone) emits all 74
  ShowFrames with PlaceObject2 moves on every frame (motion tweens) and
  RemoveObject/re-place at keyframes. Authored stop() frame scripts appear at
  sprite-frames 24/44/73 only (bytecode 07960100031700 = Stop; ...). The maxFrames
  is correctly computed via layerFrameCount() (74), not l.frames.length (16).
- (d) No stop() on the MC's frame 1. First stop is at sprite-frame 24.

So the published SWF is structurally a correct, auto-playing nested DefineSprite,
yet Ruffle holds it on frame 1. The defect is therefore in the runtime-playback
contract of the emitted SWF for nested sprites (something Ruffle reads to decide
the child sprite is stopped), NOT in the import classification or the loop-control
clip-action synthesis.

## Where to look next (fix direction)
1. There appears to be NO existing e2e oracle that proves a NESTED MovieClip
   advances its OWN timeline in headless Ruffle (motion-tween.spec.ts only
   exercises a ROOT-timeline tween). Add one as the acceptance oracle: place a
   multi-frame MC on the root once, run in bundled Ruffle, assert mc._currentframe
   advances past 1 over ticks (the exact harness used to prove this bug: 2-frame
   root with `trace('cf=' + mc._currentframe)`, read via player.traceObserver).
2. Investigate why the child DefineSprite does not tick: compare a known-good
   third-party SWF with an animating nested MC against ours, tag-by-tag (header
   FileAttributes — ours decoded as empty {}; SetBackgroundColor; the DefineSprite
   SpriteID/FrameCount; whether the nested ShowFrame count vs declared FrameCount
   match; AVM1 root DoAction that might call stop() on children). Check whether a
   stray stop()/global SWF flag or a missing/incorrect FileAttributes/initial-play
   state causes Ruffle to leave nested sprites paused. Confirm against
   ruffle/core/src/display_object/movie_clip.rs run_frame / playing default.
3. If a CLEAN (non-Magnet) compiled multi-frame MC also freezes, the bug is in the
   compiler's sprite/root emission; if only Magnet-imported MCs freeze, look at an
   import-specific artifact on the timeline/frames.

## Priority
HIGH — an entire MovieClip's animation does not play (core playback). Likely
affects every nested MovieClip in every imported FLA, not just Symbol 6.

## Evidence artifacts (reproducible)
- Standalone build: load Magnet.fla, place only symbol-81 on a multi-frame root,
  compileDocument({compress:false}); swf-dump shows the 74-frame sprite + a clean
  PlaceObject2 (no clipActions).
- Runtime: bundled Ruffle traceObserver yields cf=1 forever for mc._currentframe.
